title: Most Used Letters First
statement: A sign maker wants to know which letters to order the most of. Given a word, return a new string with the same letters arranged so the most frequent letter comes first, all copies of a letter stay together, and letters used equally often are in alphabetical order. The word uses only lowercase letters.

answerKey.pattern: Count each letter (hash map or array of 26), sort the distinct letters by count descending then alphabetically, and build the string
keyPoints: Count how often each letter appears
Sort the distinct letters with a comparator: higher count first, then alphabetical
Append each letter count times, using an array or StringBuilder
There are at most 26 distinct letters, so the sort itself is tiny
answerKey.timeComplexity: O(n) to count and build, plus sorting at most 26 letters
answerKey.spaceComplexity: O(n) for the result, O(1) for 26 counts
edgeCases: All letters equally frequent: plain alphabetical order
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sorting all n characters with a comparator that looks up counts: O(n log n)

hints: Before you can sort by 'how often', you need to know how often. What structure from Level 3 counts things?
Count the letters, then sort only the distinct letters: by count, largest first, and by letter when counts tie.
Build the answer by repeating each letter its count times, in that sorted order. Use an array join or a StringBuilder.
